ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B2-2,
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 30-F in

the area bound by:

West 119" Street; South Eggleston Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West
419" Street; and a line 56.58 feet west of and parallel to South Eggleston Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
